name: Citizenship by Naturalisation (Granting on Request, Standard Track)

requirements.blocker_text: Holder of long-term or permanent residence status, and legally resident in Romania for at least 8 years (Law 21/1991, Article 8(1)(a)).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 8 years of continuous legal residence under long-term/permanent residence status.

requirements.blocker_text: Knowledge of the Romanian language, and of the Constitution and national anthem, is required for all applicants -- made explicitly mandatory (rather than merely assessed case-by-case) by Law 14/2025's amendments.
Legal means of subsistence, good conduct with no disqualifying criminal record, age 18+, and demonstrated loyalty to the Romanian state (no actions against rule of law/national security).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 8 years' continuous legal residence under long-term/permanent status
Civil status documents (originals or certified multilingual extracts issued within the prior 2 years, per Law 14/2025)
Biometric photograph and fingerprints (mandatory since 25 July 2024)

sources.title: Refworld (UNHCR) -- Romanian Citizenship Law 21/1991 (English translation, consolidated as of May 2025), Article 8: naturalisation on request requires long-term/permanent residence status and 8 years' legal residence (5 years if married to and cohabiting with a Romanian citizen -- see ro_citizenship_by_marriage.json), age 18+, loyalty, legal means, good conduct, Romanian language and constitutional knowledge; Article 8(2)-(3) reduction of up to 3 years for EU/EEA/Swiss citizens with economic/cultural contribution, Romania-born applicants with legally resident parents, and integrated refugees

Legal 500 -- analysis of Romanian citizenship law tightening: mandatory Romanian language requirement for all applicants, and a cited approval-rate collapse from 88% (2018) to 0.37% (2023) with no approvals recorded through March 2025
